text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Summary: The boundary pointer i acts as a wall. Every item <= pivot is swapped behind the wall (left side).
At the end, swapping the pivot with the wall places the pivot exactly where it belongs for eternity.
